summary: Ocean Power Technologies filed an 8-K on August 17, 2026, announcing its Board of Directors initiated a strategic alternatives review to maximize shareholder value. The company retained Bowen, Inc. as financial advisor. The review considers a full range of options including accelerating growth, expanding market access, and strengthening financial position. No specific deal terms, price, or premium disclosed. Management emphasized continued operations and no set timetable. The strategic review process is ongoing, with no assurance of a transaction, and the company will not comment until a course of action is approved.
